decision: Retain G4 with batch 128. Median throughput is 1,503 examples/s, versus A100's best tested 1,111 examples/s at batch 512: G4 is 35.3% faster. Batch 256 and 512 reduced G4 speed by 3.3% and 10.0%; batch 1024 ran out of memory on both GPUs. G4 has about 3% better measured examples per compute unit than A100's larger-batch winner, a small difference that should not be overinterpreted from a short probe. No training recipe or model weights changed.
hardware_availability: Colab could not allocate the requested H100 and substituted G4. That duplicate probe was stopped and is excluded from this comparison. A100 allocation was verified as NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB. Quoted rates observed in this session were 8.9 units/hour for G4 and 6.77 for A100. Both runtimes were released; G4 is selected but disconnected.
limitations: Two short rounds on 8192 original rows from one shard. Setup, authorization and checkpoint I/O are outside timed throughput. These are not full-training speed or quality guarantees. Compare changed batch sizes on accuracy before adoption.
